2607.26201.title: (EC)2: Event-Centric Explainability for Cybersecurity Through Multi-Agent LLM Investigations
2607.26201.paper_summary: Security operations centers rely on anomaly detection systems to flag suspicious events. Feature-level explanations for anomaly detectors offer limited value for operational investigations. To effectively handle alerts, analysts need to know contextual relationships and need actionable understanding of the entities involved. This paper introduces an event-centric detector-agnostic approach for explaining cybersecurity alerts in small- to medium-sized enterprise networks. We present (EC)2, a multi-agent framework that performs structured, hypothesis-driven investigation to provide explanations grounded in verifiable evidence. Evaluation results show that the proposed framework improves post-detection analysis by generating operationally meaningful explanations, which also enhance event classification accuracy.
2607.26201.paper_summary_zh: 安全運營中心依賴異常檢測系統來標記可疑事件。<lb/>異常檢測器的特徵級解釋對於操作調查的價值有限。<lb/>為了有效處理警報，分析師需要了解上下文關係，並需要對所涉及的實體有可行的理解。<lb/>本文介紹了一種以事件為中心的檢測器無關方法，用於解釋中小型企業網絡中的網絡安全警報。<lb/>我們提出了(EC)2，一個多代理框架，進行結構化的假設驅動調查，以提供基於可驗證證據的解釋。<lb/>評估結果顯示，所提出的框架通過生成操作上有意義的解釋來改善檢測後分析，這也提高了事件分類的準確性。
